item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President ceremonially designates commemorative days; this does not govern agencies or alter legal rights.","evidence":"do hereby proclaim December 10, 1963, as Human Rights Day"},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The segment completes a ceremonial designation and makes hortatory appeals to the public, without directing agency governance or changing legal rights.","evidence":"call upon the people of the United States to observe the week December 10-17 as Human Rights Week"}]}
